stem.text: The circumference of a tree stem was measured continually for 48 hours.
The results are shown on the chart recording.

stem.alt: Chart recording of circumference of tree stem against time of day over 48 hours, with time marks 12 00, 24 00, 12 00, 24 00 and 12 00.

stem.text: What explains the changes in circumference recorded during the 48 hours?

A.text: Adhesion forces decrease during the night.

B.text: Cohesive tension forces increase during the day.

C.text: Mass flow of sucrose increases during the night.

D.text: Root pressure decreases during the day.
